question: What were the coprimary endpoints of the A-BRAVE trial?
expected_answer: Disease-free survival (DFS) in the intention-to-treat (ITT) population and disease-free survival in the stratum B population.

question: What treatment was evaluated in the A-BRAVE trial?
expected_answer: One year of adjuvant avelumab versus observation.

question: Which patients were included in stratum B of the A-BRAVE trial?
expected_answer: Patients with invasive residual disease in the breast and/or nodes after neoadjuvant chemotherapy.

question: Did avelumab significantly improve disease-free survival in the A-BRAVE trial?
expected_answer: No. Avelumab did not significantly improve disease-free survival.

question: What was the overall survival hazard ratio reported for avelumab in the A-BRAVE trial?
expected_answer: The reported hazard ratio for overall survival was 0.66.
